title: First Location controlled write gate
purpose: Create or verify exactly one simple Universaarl location as the first low-risk master-data write after TARGET-036.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036 result exists and selects Location as first controlled master-data write route.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Locations page opens without company switch.
No Customer, Vendor or Item template dialog is involved.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
New opens an unrelated page, document, setup wizard or template flow.
A dialog asks to confirm data creation outside the Location card.
Required fields beyond Code and Name are unclear.
SAAR-HL already exists with different meaning or unsafe settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Before screenshot shows Locations page context.
If SAAR-HL does not exist, only Code and Name are entered.
If SAAR-HL already exists, no duplicate is created and existing record is documented.
Reopen proof shows SAAR-HL and Saarbruecken Hauptlager in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No setup, document draft, Preview Posting, Posting, Payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.
Result JSON includes screenshot QA and a Next-Step Decision Card.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036 selected Location SAAR-HL as the first controlled master-data write after read-only master-data preflight.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Location remains the smallest useful master-data write: it has a clear Code/Name route and avoids accounting/template fields.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: After the first simple Location exists, the next risky master-data family should be discovered read-only before creation.
Preview still needs real customer/vendor/item master data and accepted VAT/posting boundaries.
Posting remains blocked until Preview Posting and expected entry traces exist.
Parked VAT, Page 314, inventory posting and default-dimension blockers should be revisited before first document flow.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: The next high-value step is to understand Customer/Vendor/Item template dialogs before any accounting-relevant master-data write.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not create customers, vendors or items before template/dialog discovery.
Do not treat SAAR-HL as warehouse readiness.
Do not run Preview Posting or Posting.
requiredPreparation: Keep the next case read-only or dialog-cancel-safe for Customer, Vendor and Item New routes.

result: SAAR-HL / Saarbruecken Hauptlager is visible after controlled Location write/verify and filtered reopen proof.
